workflows.name: ribo_qc_and_quantification
workflows.intent: Load a .ribo file, perform quality control checks (read length distribution and metagene analysis), and extract region-specific counts.
workflows.stages: 1. Initialize the Ribo object using Ribo() with optional transcript renaming. ;; 2. Plot and retrieve read length distribution using plot_length_distribution() and get_length_distribution(). ;; 3. Perform metagene analysis around start/stop sites using plot_metagene(), get_metagene(), and get_tidy_metagene(). ;; 4. Quantify and plot region counts (UTR5, CDS, UTR3, and junctions) using plot_region_counts() and get_region_counts(). ;; 5. Retrieve region coordinates and lengths using get_internal_region_coordinates() and get_internal_region_lengths().
workflows.code:
file.path <- system.file("extdata", "HEK293_ingolia.ribo", package = "ribor")
original.ribo <- Ribo(file.path, rename = rename_default )
original.ribo
plot_length_distribution(x           = original.ribo,
                         region      = "CDS",
                         range.lower = 28,
                         range.upper = 32,
                         fraction    = TRUE)
plot_length_distribution(x           = original.ribo,
                         region      = "CDS",
                         range.lower = 28,
                         range.upper = 32,
                         fraction    = FALSE)
rc <- get_length_distribution(ribo.object      = original.ribo,
                                   region      = "CDS",
                                   range.lower = 28,
                                   range.upper = 32)
get_info(original.ribo)$attributes$metagene_radius
plot_metagene(original.ribo,
              site        = "start",
              experiment  = c("GSM1606107"),
              range.lower = 28,
              range.upper = 32)
plot_metagene(original.ribo,
              site        = "stop",
              normalize   = TRUE,
              title       = "Stop Site Coverage",
              range.lower = 28,
              range.upper = 32)
meta.start <- get_metagene(ribo.object = original.ribo, 
                           site        = "start",
                           range.lower = 28,
                           range.upper = 32,
                           length      = TRUE,
                           transcript  = TRUE)
tidy.meta.start <- get_tidy_metagene(ribo.object = original.ribo,
                                     site        = "start",
                                     range.lower = 28,
                                     range.upper = 32,
                                     length      = TRUE)
plot_metagene(tidy.meta.start, normalize = TRUE)
plot_region_counts(x           = original.ribo,
                   range.lower = 28,
                   range.upper = 32)
rc <- get_region_counts(original.ribo,
                        range.lower = 28,
                        range.upper = 32,
                        length      = TRUE,
                        transcript  = TRUE,
                        region      = c("CDS"))
rc <- get_region_counts(original.ribo,
                        range.lower = 28,
                        range.upper = 32,
                        tidy        = FALSE)
alias.ribo    <- Ribo(file.path, rename = rename_default)
region_coord <- get_internal_region_coordinates(ribo.object = alias.ribo , alias = TRUE)
region_lengths <- get_internal_region_lengths(ribo.object = alias.ribo, alias = TRUE)

workflows.name: translational_efficiency_and_optional_data
workflows.intent: Extract optional coverage and RNA-Seq data from a .ribo file to perform translational efficiency analysis.
input: HEK293_ingolia.ribo (containing optional coverage and RNA-Seq datasets)
workflows.stages: 1. Check for optional data fields (coverage, RNA-Seq, metadata) using get_info(). ;; 2. Retrieve metadata using get_metadata(). ;; 3. Extract nucleotide-level coverage for specific transcripts using get_coverage(). ;; 4. Extract RNA-Seq region counts using get_rnaseq(). ;; 5. Calculate translational efficiency by dividing ribosome profiling CDS counts by RNA-Seq CDS counts.
workflows.code:
file.path <- system.file("extdata", "HEK293_ingolia.ribo", package = "ribor")
original.ribo <- Ribo(file.path, rename = rename_default )
experiment.info <- get_info(ribo.object = original.ribo)[['experiment.info']]
has.metadata <- experiment.info[experiment.info$metadata == TRUE, "experiment"]
experiment <- has.metadata[1]
get_metadata(ribo.object = original.ribo,
             name        = experiment,
             print       = TRUE)
has.coverage <- experiment.info[experiment.info$coverage == TRUE, "experiment"]
cov <- get_coverage(ribo.object = original.ribo,
                    name        = "MYC-206",
                    range.lower = 28,
                    range.upper = 32,
                    length      = TRUE,
                    alias       = TRUE,
                    tidy        = TRUE,
                    experiment  = has.coverage)
has.rnaseq <- experiment.info[experiment.info$rna.seq == TRUE, "experiment"]
rnaseq <- get_rnaseq(ribo.object = original.ribo,
                     tidy        = FALSE,
                     alias       = TRUE,
                     experiment  = has.rnaseq)
rnaseq_CDS <- get_rnaseq(ribo.object = original.ribo,
                         tidy        = TRUE,
                         alias       = TRUE,
                         region      = "CDS",
                         compact     = FALSE,
                         experiment  = "GSM1606108")
rc_CDS <- get_region_counts(ribo.object    = original.ribo,
                                tidy       = TRUE,
                                alias      = TRUE,
                                transcript = FALSE,
                                region     = "CDS",
                                compact    = FALSE,
                                experiment = "GSM1606108")
filtered_transcripts <- which(rnaseq_CDS$count > 2 & rc_CDS$count > 2)
rnaseq_CDS           <- rnaseq_CDS[filtered_transcripts, ]
rc_CDS               <- rc_CDS[filtered_transcripts, ]
te_CDS    <- rc_CDS$count/rnaseq_CDS$count
high_te <- rc_CDS$transcript[which(te_CDS > .25)]
